scenarios.name: Successful Startup & Shutdown
scenarios.details: Verified clean state machine loop: idle -> starting -> capturing -> stopping -> idle
scenarios.notes: Session ID generated, AudioContext initialized, teardown cleans memory.

scenarios.name: Backend Unavailable at Startup
scenarios.details: Connection refused caught cleanly; UI displays 'Backend Offline' alert; capture blocked.

scenarios.name: Backend Interruption Mid-Session
scenarios.details: Timeout (8.0s) / fetch failure caught; TRANSCRIPTION_ERROR dispatched; queue flushed on stop.
scenarios.notes: Offscreen worker safely recovers without memory accumulation.

scenarios.name: Silence & Empty Transcription
scenarios.details: VAD rejects empty audio; status returns 'empty'; avatar holds neutral pose without gestures.

scenarios.name: Low-Confidence Transcription (<0.60)
scenarios.details: Word probabilities aggregated; warning badge displayed (e.g. '45% (Low ASR Confidence)'); neutral sign held.
scenarios.notes: User alerted to potential speech recognition uncertainty.

scenarios.name: Supported NAMASTE Routing
scenarios.details: Resolved token 'namaste' -> gloss NAMASTE -> animationId 'isl_namaste_godl_v1' (ISLRTC GODL v1.0).

scenarios.name: Unanimated Dictionary Entry Handling
scenarios.details: Gloss THANK_YOU in seed lexicon with animationId=null. Router generates neutral rest pose.
scenarios.notes: Status: 'Words in dictionary, 3D animation awaiting qualified review'.

scenarios.name: Out-of-Lexicon Phrase Handling
scenarios.details: Phrase 'quantum computing rocket' surfaces tokens as unsupportedWords: ['quantum', 'computing', 'rocket'].
scenarios.notes: Avatar holds neutral rest pose with zero synthetic motion.

scenarios.name: Duplicate / Out-of-Order Transcript Events
scenarios.details: Monotonic sequence check (sequenceId <= lastProcessedSeqId) successfully drops stale/duplicate packets.
scenarios.notes: Verified via Stage 1 unit and E2E browser tests.

scenarios.name: Queue Saturation & Bounded History
scenarios.details: Audio queue capped at MAX_QUEUE_SIZE=3 with shift() drop; transcript history capped at 30 items.

scenarios.name: Avatar Window Closed & Reopened Mid-Session
scenarios.details: On initialization, avatar_player.html queries chrome.storage.session('captureState') and reconnects.
scenarios.notes: Seamless resumption of active broadcast stream.

scenarios.name: Tab Closure & Audio Track Teardown
scenarios.details: MediaStreamTrack.onended triggers CAPTURE_TRACK_ENDED event; background shuts down session cleanly.
scenarios.notes: Offscreen document destroyed; status resets to IDLE.

scenarios.name: Permission Denial & Recovery
scenarios.details: Permission rejection on chrome:// or user cancel caught; error surfaced; state transitions to IDLE.
scenarios.notes: User can immediately retry on valid tab.

scenarios.name: Local Session Data Cleanup
scenarios.details: Session stop clears transcript arrays; closing browser wipes chrome.storage.session RAM.
scenarios.notes: Zero lingering audio files or transcripts on disk.

scenarios.name: Synthetic Incident & Rollback Procedure
scenarios.details: Simulated incident INC-TEST-001 handled; verified instant fallback to baseline.

scenarios.name: Export of Test-Only Results Schema
scenarios.details: Test results exported complying with schema (runId=dryrun_m4_48f086d1).
scenarios.notes: Schema strictly requires isSynthetic=true and isHumanReview=false.

scenarios.name: Review Store Segregation & Anti-Pollution
scenarios.details: Dry-run test results and synthetic reviews prohibited from reviews/ directory.
scenarios.notes: Review validator rejects synthetic flags, ensuring genuine human-review store remains unpolluted.
